title: eragrostis eragrostis var. microstachya
intro: Eragrostis eragrostis var. microstachya, commonly known as  'Wild Rice', is a type of grass that belongs to the family Poaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and improve digestion.
